intent: Promotes durable cross-task lessons into project memory (product/learnings) and the decision log, separating durable from disposable, reading before writing so it appends not clobbers, and grounding every rule in cited evidence.

dimensions.name: durable-vs-disposable
dimensions.criterion: Persists only lessons that govern future work; task-local notes are left alone.

dimensions.name: memory-ratchet
dimensions.criterion: Standing rules persist in the product-scope memory store (product/learnings).

dimensions.name: read-before-write
dimensions.criterion: Reads the current rules before writing so it appends rather than clobbers.

dimensions.name: lesson-as-decision
dimensions.criterion: A rule that governs a standing choice is logged with fac decision.

dimensions.name: reflection-band-artifact
dimensions.criterion: Records the promotion as a reflection-band run artifact (09-learn.md).
